title: DeShare
tagline: A Decentralised Content sharing with web2 like experience, and Smart contract based Incentive
description:
- DeShare is a DApp that makes decentralized content sharing possible.DeShare enables content creators to connect with viewers, create and publish great content, follow other creators, and earn tokens in return.
- It has some additional feature that makes it different from other decentralized/centralized content sharing platform 
 - We have designed this with the needs of web2 users in mind. It aims to help users to onboard on Social Media platforms that are built on top of lens protocol with their google account.
 - DeShare takes care of Addiction to media. that's why we provide only 60 viewToken per day to interact with the platform  
 - DeShare has great tokenomics for incentivization of content creators. Creators will receive an inventive score based on their content, viewership, and view rate. This score will be used to calculate the amount of viewToken they will receive for their content.
how_its_made:
- We had to learn lens protocol and Biconomy from scratch.
- We had to learn how to use web3storage and IPFS.
- The Tokenomics of DeShare is very complex and we had to make sure that it is bug free.
